title_en: Godzilla vs. King Kong, Degen Dip-Buyers and Anthropic
title_zh: Godzilla 大战 King Kong、Degen 逢低买家与 Anthropic（主持 Joel Weber；嘉宾：Bloomberg Intelligence 的 Athanasios Psarofagis、Bloomberg TV 的 Isabel Lee）
subtitle_zh: Vanguard 反超 BlackRock、韩国杠杆 ETF 震动政坛，以及 Anthropic 上市前的 ETF 抢跑。
summary_zh: 本期 Trillions 因 Eric Balchunas 出差，由 Joel Weber 主持，请来 Bloomberg Intelligence ETF 分析师 Athanasios Psarofagis 与 Bloomberg TV 市场记者 Isabel Lee，做一期'ETF 大杂烩'。首要话题是'Godzilla 大战 King Kong'——Vanguard 与 BlackRock 的资产规模缠斗：Psarofagis 提到团队 James Safar 的报告，几个月前 Vanguard 一度反超未能稳住，而这次看来正在把对手甩开，主要靠便宜的核心（core）被动股票产品；Lee 补充自 2020 年以来 Vanguard 被动股票份额上升五个百分点，是'强者愈强'的又一例证。不过放眼全球仍是 iShares 的天下（品牌源自 Barclays、在欧洲根基深），BlackRock 全球资产规模依然更大，Vanguard 正罕见地主动进攻、加码债券线以争夺 iShares 领先的份额。第二个话题是'辣酱货架'上产品的保质期，如 SK Hynix 一多一空两只 ETF 在狂热顶点发行后迅速清盘，以及韩国杠杆 ETF（leveraged ETF）竟闹到国会与两党政治层面。'赌徒'（degen）资金方面，半导体近期回调却遭凶猛逢低买入（buy the dip）。最后是'要还是不要'：Anthropic 上市前（pre-IPO）的 ETF 抢跑，节目类比此前 SpaceX 那一幕，讨论其估值传闻高达 2 万亿美元、以及能否重现首日天量成交。
description: Godzilla vs. King Kong, Degen Dip-Buyers and Anthropic

turns.en: Bloomberg Audio Studios.
turns.zh: Bloomberg Audio Studios。

turns.en: Podcasts. Radio. News. Welcome to Trillions. I'm Joel Weber. Eric Balchunas is traveling. So joining me for this episode, I have Athanasios Sarifakis, an ETF analyst with Bloomberg Intelligence, as well as Isabel Lee, a markets reporter with Bloomberg TV. And we have a few themes to explore. We've got a big data point, which is In the latest chapter between Godzilla and King Kong, Vanguard, BlackRock. We also have a hot sauce shelf where some products seem to have an expiration date. And then we're going to go explore how some investors are continuing to buy the dip and where they're doing that. That's in our DGN report. And then finally, yeah or nah? We're going to explore the pre-IPO anticipation around Anthropic, which is Smells a lot like what we saw with SpaceX earlier this year. This time on Trillions, ETF grab bag. Ethan, Isabel, welcome back to Trillions.
turns.zh: 播客、电台、新闻。欢迎收听 Trillions，我是 Joel Weber。Eric Balchunas 这期在出差，所以今天陪我一起的是两位：Bloomberg Intelligence 的 ETF 分析师 Athanasios Psarofagis，以及 Bloomberg TV 的市场记者 Isabel Lee。我们有几个话题要聊。先是一个重磅数据点——Godzilla 大战 King Kong 的最新一章，也就是 Vanguard 和 BlackRock。我们还有一个『辣酱货架』（hot sauce shelf），上面有些产品似乎是有保质期的。接着我们会去看看，一些投资者是怎么持续逢低买入（buy the dip）、又在买些什么，这部分在我们的 DGN 报告里。最后是『要还是不要』（yeah or nah）？我们会聊聊 Anthropic 上市前（pre-IPO）的这股期待劲儿，它闻起来非常像今年早些时候 SpaceX 的那一幕。本期 Trillions，ETF 大杂烩。Ethan、Isabel，欢迎回到 Trillions。

turns.en: Excited to be here. I thought you were going to say you're stuck with us. I am.
turns.zh: 很高兴来这儿。我还以为你会说『你们俩算是甩不掉了』。我倒是（很乐意）。

turns.en: But I am excited to have a few themes that we get to explore together. Okay, Ethan, I'm going to put the spotlight on you for a second. Topic number one we're going to talk about, big data point of note, Vanguard and BlackRock. A couple months ago, we wrote about how Vanguard had surpassed BlackRock, and I was like, oh, game over. Turns out it wasn't totally game over. What happened?
turns.zh: 不过我确实很期待今天能一起聊这几个话题。好，Ethan，我先把你推到聚光灯下。第一个话题，一个值得关注的重磅数据点：Vanguard 和 BlackRock。几个月前我们写过 Vanguard 在资产规模上超过了 BlackRock，当时我心想，哦，大局已定了。结果发现还没完全定局。到底发生了什么？

turns.en: James Safar on our team had wrote this note about Vanguard passing BlackRock in assets. Like you mentioned, it happened a couple months ago. didn't really hold. This one looks like it might hold.
turns.zh: 我们团队的 James Safar 写过一份报告，讲 Vanguard 在资产规模上超过 BlackRock。就像你说的，那是几个月前发生的事，没能稳住。而这一次看起来可能会稳住。

turns.en: It ended up being like neck and neck and they were tussling and it, but it seems like maybe now Vanguard has closed the door. Yeah.
turns.zh: 最后两家其实是不相上下、你来我往地缠斗，但现在看来 Vanguard 也许已经把门关上了。是的。

turns.en: It seems like they're starting to run away with it, but this is basically like King Kong and Godzilla, like fighting, like that's the level. So they're kind of going back and forth and everyone else is just kind of fighting for what's left over. But, um, I think is, you know, we knew it was maybe going to happen eventually, but it's really just a big deal. And it actually finally happened.
turns.zh: 看起来他们开始把对手甩开了，但这基本上就像 King Kong 大战 Godzilla，就是那个量级的对决。两家你来我往，其他人只能在剩下的份额里抢一抢。不过，嗯，我觉得，你知道，我们早就知道这事迟早会发生，但它真的是件大事，而且现在它终于发生了。

turns.en: Right.
turns.zh: 对。

turns.en: And, um, It's interesting just because Vanguard's lineup isn't really the most exciting, right? It's just mostly the core stuff. It's cheap. And that's really what got them passed. And BlackRock, I felt like, was really trying to fend them off. They went with Bitcoin. They were launching active, right? And so they're trying to keep this lead as long as they can. But it just seemed like this inevitable move that Vanguard was going to pass them eventually.
turns.zh: 而且，嗯，有意思的是，Vanguard 的产品阵容其实算不上最激动人心的，对吧？大多都是核心（core）类产品，费率又便宜，而正是这一点让他们实现了反超。BlackRock 那边，我感觉是真的在努力抵挡——他们上了 Bitcoin，还在推主动型（active）产品，对吧？所以他们想尽办法把这个领先地位守得越久越好。但这看起来就是个大势所趋——Vanguard 迟早会超过他们。

turns.en: I agree with the Thanasis.
turns.zh: 我同意 Athanasios 的看法。

turns.en: This is very interesting because also since 2020, Vanguard's share of passive equity assets rose five percentage points. And when you think of the ETF growth as of late as Joel and Eric Balchunas, you guys would always talk about this, you would think it's active, active, active, but then it's still passive that's out there. Also, it's just another emblematic example of how the big is getting bigger.
turns.zh: 这一点非常有意思，因为自 2020 年以来，Vanguard 在被动股票资产（passive equity assets）里的份额上升了五个百分点。说到 ETF 近年的增长——Joel、Eric Balchunas，你们俩总爱聊这个——你会以为是主动、主动、主动，但结果市场上占主导的还是被动（passive）。而且这也是『强者愈强』的又一个标志性例子。

turns.en: And Joel, you alluded to this, the small is just having a harder time.
turns.zh: 而且 Joel，你刚才也提到了这一点——小玩家的日子就是越来越难过。

turns.en: Well, there are characters other than You know, Godzilla and King Kong.
turns.zh: 嗯，除了 Godzilla 和 King Kong，其实还有别的角色。

turns.en: King Kong.
turns.zh: King Kong。

turns.en: But another thing that was kind of interesting here is that if you think about U.S., that's one story. What about globally?
turns.zh: 但这里还有一点也挺有意思：如果你只盯着美国，那是一个故事；放到全球看呢？

turns.en: Yeah, globally, it's very much iShares. They have a much stronger brand recognition, especially in Europe, because their roots are actually from Barclays. So they have a lot of like European roots there. Vanguard is definitely growing in that region, but they don't quite have the recognition that some of the other firms do. But if we sort of look at global assets, BlackRock is still larger for sure. But this is just very much on the U.S. focus. It's mostly equities for Vanguard that pulled it along. But the interesting thing is they're starting to really ramp up their bond offering because iShare still leads there. And I think that it's very rare to see Vanguard go like on the offensive. And so I think they're ramping up their bond offering to try to go after some of that bond share now that BlackRock has held on to for so long.
turns.zh: 是啊，放眼全球，那基本就是 iShares 的天下了。他们的品牌认知度要强得多，尤其是在欧洲，因为他们的根基其实来自 Barclays，所以在欧洲有很深的渊源。Vanguard 在那个地区肯定也在增长，但认知度还比不上其他一些公司。不过如果看全球资产规模，BlackRock 依然更大，这是肯定的。只是这次主要聚焦在美国，拉动 Vanguard 的主要是股票类产品。有意思的是，他们开始大力加码债券产品线，因为那块目前还是 iShares 领先。我觉得很少见到 Vanguard 这么主动进攻，所以他们加码债券产品，是想从 BlackRock 长期牢牢握着的债券份额里抢下一块。

turns.en: Is there a number in all of this that you think people should be focusing on or thinking about?
turns.zh: 在这一堆信息里，有没有哪个数字是你觉得大家应该重点关注或者琢磨的？

turns.en: I don't know if an actual number, but I can already tell you where I think critics are going to come in. It's going to be about the ownership level, right? Like how much is Vanguard owning of all these stocks and put that together with BlackRock. So I think that might start to reemerge again, sort of having those conversations. So yeah, that'd be what I'd be looking out for.
turns.zh: 具体数字我说不好，但我已经能告诉你批评的声音会从哪儿切入——会是持股比例（ownership level）的问题，对吧？就是 Vanguard 到底持有了这些股票的多少，再把它和 BlackRock 加在一起算。所以我觉得这类讨论可能会重新冒出来。是的，这就是我会盯着看的点。

turns.en: Okay, topic number two. Eric's not here. This would be his favorite thing to talk about. The hot sauce shelf where there's a lot of product innovation and excitement and all that non-core stuff, like the spicy stuff, the shiny objects, if you will. What is a story on the hot sauce shelf that has caught your attention of late?
turns.zh: 好，第二个话题。Eric 今天不在，而这本来会是他最爱聊的东西——『辣酱货架』，那里有大量产品创新和热闹的非核心玩意儿，就是那些重口味的、花里胡哨的『亮点产品』（shiny objects）。最近辣酱货架上有什么故事引起了你的注意？

turns.en: Let's start with closures in Trader. They closed these SK Hynix levered.
turns.zh: 先说说清盘（closure）吧，发行人是 Trader。他们把这两只 SK Hynix 的杠杆（levered）产品清掉了。

turns.en: That's an issuer, Trader.
turns.zh: 这是一家发行人，叫 Trader。

turns.en: Yeah.
turns.zh: 对。

turns.en: Take away the E, though.
turns.zh: 不过要把那个 E 去掉。

turns.en: Yeah, drop the E, so it's T-R-A-D-R. Sounds like a rapper name. Trader.
turns.zh: 对，去掉 E，所以是 T-R-A-D-R。听起来像个说唱歌手的名字。Trader。

turns.en: Trader.
turns.zh: Trader。

turns.en: They closed these SK Hynix ETFs.
turns.zh: 他们把这几只 SK Hynix ETF 清盘了。

turns.en: One was a long and one was a short.
turns.zh: 一只是做多（long），一只是做空（short）。

turns.en: Yep, long and a short. They launched it during the whole craze with all that stuff going up. But that's kind of the danger of it, right? Timing with some of these products matters. And if you really don't have this big jump out of the gate, you're kind of fighting this uphill battle. And that's what they had to do. And so they're shutting these down.
turns.zh: 没错，一多一空。他们是在那波所有相关标的都往上涨的狂热期里发行的。但这恰恰就是风险所在，对吧？这类产品的发行时点很重要。如果一开始没能一炮打响、迅速上量，那你基本就是在逆水行舟。他们当时就撞上了这情况，所以现在把这些产品关掉了。

turns.en: Isabel, the fever has subsided on SK Hynix. What catches your attention with this hot sauce conversation?
turns.zh: Isabel，SK Hynix 的这股热已经退了。在这场『辣酱』话题里，什么引起了你的注意？

turns.en: For me, I.
turns.zh: 对我来说，我……

turns.en: I'm just still so shocked that in South Korea, the presidential chief of staff offered to resign, and I guess resigned a few months back, I think in September.
turns.zh: 我到现在还非常震惊：在韩国，总统秘书室室长（presidential chief of staff）主动请辞，我记得是几个月前——大概是九月——真的辞职了。

turns.en: Because of all of this leverage ETFs. It's just so interesting. I mean, in the US, we talk about it a lot, but outside of the U.S., it actually reached politics.
turns.zh: 就是因为这些杠杆 ETF（leverage ETFs）。这事儿太有意思了。在美国，我们经常聊它，但在美国以外，它居然真的闹到了政治层面。

turns.en: I mean, it's a bipartisan topic that they are talking about. I had to reread the headline twice. I think they've really talked about it in Congress. Can you imagine the president of a country talking about leveraged ETFs? That's how you know you've made it.
turns.zh: 我是说，这已经是两党（bipartisan）都在讨论的话题了。那条标题我读了两遍才敢信。我想他们真的在国会里讨论过。你能想象一个国家的总统在谈杠杆 ETF 吗？这就说明这玩意儿是真的『混出名堂』了。

turns.en: I mean, I can kind of see Trump doing that, to be honest with you. Like, maybe?
turns.zh: 老实说，Trump 干出这种事我倒是能想象得到。也许吧？

turns.en: Yeah, fine.
turns.zh: 嗯，也对。

turns.en: That is true. But yes, I still can't get over this story. And we write the ETF newsletter every week called... ETF IQ. And we've tackled this South Korean leverage ETF phenomenon for a few times because it's just so fascinating. It took the market by storm. And then when they tried to ban it, you saw volume actually collapse.
turns.zh: 这话没错。但是，我还是没法从这个故事里缓过神来。我们每周都写一份 ETF 简报，叫……ETF IQ。韩国这个杠杆 ETF 现象我们已经写过好几次了，因为它实在太迷人了。它一度席卷整个市场，然后当他们试图封禁它的时候，你会看到成交量真的一下子崩了。

turns.en: So I guess regulation works.
turns.zh: 所以看来监管还是管用的。

turns.en: The president used to be a day trader before he was president. Okay, next topic, the DGN report. I know the Bloomberg Intelligence ETF analysts like to talk about what the degenerates are doing. What's the chatter of note of late?
turns.zh: （韩国）总统当总统之前还做过日内交易者（day trader）呢。好，下一个话题，DGN 报告。我知道 Bloomberg Intelligence 的 ETF 分析师们爱聊那些『赌徒』（degenerates，也就是 degen）在玩什么。最近有什么值得关注的讨论？

turns.en: Well, looking at flows, it's definitely semiconductors. They have had a pretty rough run.
turns.zh: 从资金流（flows）来看，那绝对是半导体（semiconductors）。它们最近走得相当艰难。

turns.en: So the flows are in their favor or not right now?
turns.zh: 所以现在资金流对它们是有利还是不利？

turns.en: People are buying the dip pretty aggressively. So if we look at from October, they're down about maybe 17% from their highs there. Then there's been this massive rush of buying some of these ETFs. And not only just like the regular ones, the levered ones. SOXL, which is like the 3X long.
turns.zh: 大家在非常凶猛地逢低买入（buying the dip）。从十月算起，它们大概已经从高点回落了约 17%，然后就出现了一大波疯狂抢买这些 ETF 的资金。而且不只是普通的那些，还有杠杆的，比如 SOXL，也就是 3 倍做多（3X long）那只。

turns.en: That's S-O-X-L.
turns.zh: 就是 S-O-X-L。

turns.en: 3X long direction. Okay. I think that's a record month for it, full of Ys. 3X long. Yeah. So, and it's, you know, usually what's, the reason why this reflex is so strong, because it's always been rewarded, right? It's like really anytime you've bought these dips, they have tended to come back. So that reflex still hasn't been kicked yet. I think if maybe markets continue to go down, people will be a little bit more weary about this strategy, but at least right now, it is still very much like buying any kind of dip in AI-related stocks, semiconductor stocks.
turns.zh: 3 倍做多，Direction 家的。好。我想那是它资金流入创纪录的一个月。3 倍做多。是的。所以，你知道，通常这种条件反射之所以这么强，是因为它一直以来都被市场『奖励』，对吧？就是说，基本上任何时候你逢低买入，它们往往都会反弹回来。所以这个条件反射到现在还没被『戒掉』。我觉得如果市场继续往下走，大家可能会对这个策略更谨慎一些，但至少眼下，它依然非常流行——逢低就买任何 AI 相关股、半导体股的回调。

turns.en: Isabel, how do you feel about 3X semiconductors right now?
turns.zh: Isabel，你现在怎么看 3 倍做多的半导体？

turns.en: We love anything 3X. That's the hottest, hot, hot sauce. But I would like to note that so far this year, the fund has seen outflows of like $ 3.
turns.zh: 只要是 3 倍的我们都爱，那可是最火辣、火辣、火辣的辣酱。不过我想指出一点：今年到目前为止，这只基金的资金净流出大约 $3

turns.en: 85 billion.
turns.zh: ……85 billion——合起来是 $3.85 billion（约 38.5 亿美元）。

turns.en: But A part of me thinks, why should we care?
turns.zh: 但我心里又有一部分在想，我们干嘛要在意这个？

turns.en: This is supposed to be a daily trade anyway, so maybe we shouldn't be looking at it here today.
turns.zh: 反正它本来就该是日内交易（daily trade）的工具，所以也许我们今天压根不该在这儿这么盯着它看。

turns.en: What do you think, Athanasios? Do we look to the analysts?
turns.zh: 你怎么看，Athanasios？我们该听听分析师的意见吗？

turns.en: No, that's great. I think this is more short-term, but I think when you look at price drawdowns, I'm curious to see if flows come in. And that seems to be happening right now. And it's a few names. It's not just the Direction one. There's an iShares one. There's VanEck, all taking in money recently. So that reflex is still very much alive.
turns.zh: 不，你们说得很好。我觉得这更多是短线的事，但当你看到价格回撤（drawdown）的时候，我就很好奇会不会有资金流进来，而现在似乎正在发生。而且不止一只产品，不只是 Direction 那只，还有 iShares 的一只、VanEck 的一只，最近都在吸金。所以这个条件反射还活得好好的。

turns.en: Ethan, you've got a little bit of a reputation on the team at Bloomberg Intelligence for maybe not being always excited about things. Like, yeah or nah.
turns.zh: Ethan，你在 Bloomberg Intelligence 团队里有点小名气，就是你对很多事儿未必总是那么兴奋——那种『要还是不要』（yeah or nah）的调调。

turns.en: Yeah, nah.
turns.zh: 是啊……不要（Yeah, nah）。

turns.en: I'm curious. Now that we're on the other side of the Anthropic S1, which people have just been on the edge of their seat about for weeks, we get to compare it with this SpaceX IPO that happened earlier. What's your temp about ETFs and Anthropic?
turns.zh: 我很好奇。现在 Anthropic 的 S-1（上市招股书）已经尘埃落定，前几周大家可是翘首以盼、坐立不安，我们正好可以拿它跟之前那场 SpaceX IPO 做个对比。关于 ETF 和 Anthropic，你的『温度』（temp）读数是多少？

turns.en: I don't know, I can't say lukewarm, right? It's not in the middle, it's here, man.
turns.zh: 我不知道，反正我不能说『不温不火』（lukewarm），对吧？它不在中间，它就在这一头，老兄。

turns.en: But the SpaceX one, I mean, it was the most.
turns.zh: 但 SpaceX 那只，我是说，它可是史上最……

turns.en: Heavily traded IPO ever, right, on day one. So that's obviously a really tall bar to cross for Anthropic. It's going to be really close. And it's the same playbook. There are ETFs that are waiting for them to go public, levered ETFs. Any ETF that's holding even any type of exposure in Anthropic, no matter which way, is seeing demand. So it's very, very similar to what was happening with SpaceX. But once SpaceX went public, all these ETFs saw outflows and everyone just shifted over to the actual stock.
turns.zh: ……首日交易量最大的 IPO，对吧。所以对 Anthropic 来说，这显然是个非常高的门槛，不过会很接近。套路是一样的：有些 ETF 就等着它上市，还有杠杆 ETF；任何持有哪怕一丁点 Anthropic 敞口（exposure）的 ETF，不管方向如何，都在迎来需求。所以这跟当初 SpaceX 的情况非常、非常像。但 SpaceX 一上市，这些 ETF 全都出现资金流出，大家都直接转去买真正的股票了。

turns.en: Because you can get the actual thing.
turns.zh: 因为你能买到真正的标的了。

turns.en: Now you get the real thing. So I think we'll probably see that again with Anthropic. The other thing is, I feel like space was so unique.
turns.zh: 现在你能买到真家伙了。所以我觉得 Anthropic 大概率会重演这一幕。另一点是，我感觉太空（space）这个题材太独一无二了。

turns.en: Right?
turns.zh: 对吧？

turns.en: It was like really hard to kind of get exposure. Versus AI, I think there's a lot of ETFs out there already. So I don't know if people are sort of already just getting a flavor for it through other AI ETFs. If I had to guess, I don't think it'll pass the SpaceX like level day one, but it'll probably be really close.
turns.zh: 想拿到（太空的）敞口真的很难。而 AI 就不一样了，市面上已经有很多 ETF 了。所以我不确定大家是不是已经通过其他 AI ETF 尝到了这个味道。如果让我猜，我不觉得它首日能超过 SpaceX 那种量级，但应该会非常接近。

turns.en: Because there's the Elon thing, right? Like you're taking on Elon. Like that's different.
turns.zh: 因为这里面还有 Elon 的因素，对吧？就像你是在跟 Elon 较劲，那是不一样的。

turns.en: Totally, totally. But that said, it probably would still be like a massive IPO. It could be maybe even number two. But just the SpaceX hype was so strong. So it'll be really interesting to see.
turns.zh: 完全同意，完全同意。话虽如此，它大概率仍会是一场 super 大的 IPO，甚至可能排到史上第二。只是 SpaceX 当时的热度实在太猛了，所以这会很值得一看。

turns.en: Isabel, could you tell me which ETF has the most exposure to Anthropic pre-IPO? Do you know?
turns.zh: Isabel，你能告诉我哪只 ETF 在上市前（pre-IPO）对 Anthropic 的敞口最大吗？你知道吗？

turns.en: No.
turns.zh: 不知道。

turns.en: I just happened to like look up Ethan's note to figure it out. Yeah, there you go. She figured it out. Yeah, there you go. Which was also in the SpaceX conversation.
turns.zh: 我刚好去翻了一下 Ethan 的报告，弄明白了。瞧，给你。她查出来了。瞧，就是这样。这个答案在 SpaceX 那次讨论里也出现过。

turns.en: It's BAI, that's iShares, as we've talked about. But I don't know. I mean, this is what, when we were.
turns.zh: 是 BAI，iShares 那只，我们之前聊过的。不过我也说不准。我是说，这就是……当初我们在……

turns.en: Reporting this, a lot of the ETFs wanted to hold one piece of SpaceX before SpaceX went public, whether through CapTable or SPV.
turns.zh: ……报道这件事的时候，很多 ETF 都想在 SpaceX 上市之前持有它的一份股权，不管是通过 CapTable 还是 SPV（特殊目的载体）。

turns.en: And then when SpaceX went public, they weren't so unique anymore.
turns.zh: 然后等 SpaceX 一上市，这些持仓就没那么独特了。

turns.en: So you would think that an anthropic-like ETFs like this wouldn't crop up, but then no, you've seen filings dating back as early as March and really just several single stock ETFs already in registration.
turns.zh: 所以你本以为像 Anthropic 这样的 ETF 不会再冒出来了，但事实并非如此——你能看到最早可以追溯到三月的申报文件，而且已经有好几只单一股票 ETF（single stock ETFs）在走注册流程了。

turns.en: So I don't know.
turns.zh: 所以我也不好说。

turns.en: Maybe they just... Any win is a win, even if it's short-term, I guess.
turns.zh: 也许他们只是……我猜，能赢就是赢，哪怕是短期的。

turns.en: I also just think this moment of private markets and ETFs. We've now had SpaceX. We're going to have... Like, where do you go from there? Like, open AI, I guess. But like, who knows when that happens? It's just this private market moment. It feels like a 2026 story to me.
turns.zh: 我也觉得，眼下这个私募市场（private markets）与 ETF 交汇的节点很关键。我们已经有了 SpaceX，接下来还会有……你说，往下还能到哪儿去？大概是 OpenAI 吧。可谁知道那会是什么时候呢？这就是属于私募市场的时刻，在我看来，这是一个 2026 年的故事。

turns.en: Yeah, definitely. Yeah, I don't know how much bigger there is, right, than this.
turns.zh: 是的，绝对的。是啊，我不知道还有谁能比这更大，对吧。

turns.en: And even if I agree that maybe Anthropic doesn't have the narrative of SpaceX in relation to Musk, but it is trying to become even bigger than SpaceX when it comes to its IPO.
turns.zh: 而且即便我同意，Anthropic 也许没有 SpaceX 那种跟 Musk 绑在一起的故事性，但在 IPO 这件事上，它正试图变得比 SpaceX 还要大。

turns.en: Some figures put it at $ 2 trillion.
turns.zh: 有些数字把它估到了 $2 trillion（2 万亿美元）。

turns.en: That is....
turns.zh: 那可是……

turns.en: Gigantic. So maybe there is that.
turns.zh: ……大得离谱。所以也许它还真有这个分量。

turns.en: Fireworks. We'll be, we'll have you back on for them and then you can give us a, yeah, now about the fireworks.
turns.zh: 烟花（fireworks）。到时候我们会把你们请回来聊这场『烟花』，然后你们可以给我们来一句『是啊，现在说说这些烟花』。

turns.en: I'll be complaining about something else.
turns.zh: 到时候我会在吐槽别的东西。

turns.en: Okay.
turns.zh: 好。

turns.en: All right. Isabel, Ethan, thanks for joining us on Trillions.
turns.zh: 好的。Isabel、Ethan，感谢你们做客 Trillions。

turns.en: Yeah, thanks for having me on.
turns.zh: 嗯，谢谢邀请我上节目。

turns.en: Thank you, Joel. Always fun.
turns.zh: 谢谢你，Joel。一如既往地开心。

turns.en: Thanks for listening to Trillions. Until next time, you can find us on the Bloomberg terminal, Bloomberg.com, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever else you like to listen. We'd love to hear from you.
turns.zh: 感谢收听 Trillions。下期再见之前，你可以在 Bloomberg 终端、Bloomberg.com、Apple Podcasts、Spotify，或者任何你喜欢听的地方找到我们。我们很想听到你的反馈。

turns.en: Hit us up.
turns.zh: 来找我们聊聊。

turns.en: Trillions is produced by Magnus Henriksen and Keshav Pandya. Amy Keene is our executive producer. Cheryl Brumley is the head of Bloomberg Podcasts.
turns.zh: Trillions 由 Magnus Henriksen 和 Keshav Pandya 制作，Amy Keene 是我们的执行制作人（executive producer），Cheryl Brumley 是 Bloomberg Podcasts 的负责人。

turns.en: Bye.
turns.zh: 再见。
